A 45-Year Relationship

Where Art
Meets Music

For 45 years I've invested my life, my passion, and every dollar I could into music, becoming a multi-instrumentalist, songwriter, producer, and lifelong Guitar Center customer. Guitar Center has been more than a store to me. It's been part of my creative DNA.

JD Shultz — Artist · Musician · Producer
Art & Music, United02 / 05
The Vision

Beyond The Gallery,
Into The Marketplace

For 15 years my paintings have lived on the walls of Guitar Center Hollywood. Now I see an incredible opportunity to bring my artwork beyond the gallery and into the marketplace, through art-wrapped guitars, instrument cases, apparel, accessories, and immersive visual experiences.

My vision is to unite my two greatest passions, art and music, by transforming everyday products into distinctive, emotionally connected works of art that inspire musicians, celebrate individuality, and create new revenue for Guitar Center.
